Tang speakers blame Jin’s fall on chancellor 王衍’s empty reputation. That is the Hui-court 王衍 whose younger daughter 惠風 married 愍懷太子, who later held 尚書左僕射, joined 裴頠 against 賈后, led 清談, and is 字夷甫/太尉. One Jin cluster; do not drop ZZTJ members.

裴頠’s 崇有 opponents are 王衍之徒; a 黃門郎王衍 later inspects 楷. That is the same Hui-court 王衍 whose 小女惠風 married the heir. No second Jin 王衍 is supplied. Merge the whole preexisting groups; office reuse alone is not the proof.

Emperor Hui’s annal names 王衍 left vice director of the secretariat. The 愍懷 biography’s 妃父 王衍 is that same court aristocrat (daughters to 太子 and 賈謐). Merge with the other Jin 王衍/夷甫 members; keep ZZTJ rows.

032 writes courtesy-title 王夷甫, not 王衍. Packet 衍字夷甫 is the alias chain. 太尉 plus Pei granddaughter fits the Hui-court 王衍 who married daughters into the heir’s and Jia houses. English ‘Wang Yan’ alone would not suffice.
賈后’s kinsman 模 recruits 裴頠 and 王衍 to depose her; 衍悔而謀寢. That is the same 王衍 who supplied 惠風 as 太子妃 and later asked divorce. Same Jin cluster as 夷甫/左僕射/宰相.
